nodes.title: Machine
nodes.purpose: Choose Overview, Troubleshooting, Repair history, Electrical, Controls, Parts, Manuals or Photos for the selected machine. Start a repair.
nodes.visual: Readable task list. Most detailed views require scrolling. Climax cabinet fixture has no photo; do not mistake that empty state for verified production photo coverage.
nodes.functional: Eight sections and representative destinations clicked. Guided troubleshooting covered by earlier visual suite; live PLC data is not connected.

nodes.title: My work
nodes.purpose: List and resume local repair drafts and submitted work.
nodes.visual: Readable cards; “On this phone” is misleading on desktop.
nodes.functional: Repair workflow exercised in disposable technician/admin sessions.

nodes.title: Repair
nodes.purpose: Capture a machine problem, notes, files and work details; save a draft and prepare a summary.
nodes.visual: Large controls; context and draft status take substantial room before entry fields.
nodes.functional: Core repair journey passed before a later, unrelated home-layout assertion stopped the suite. Live microphone capture is unverified.

nodes.title: Finish repair
nodes.purpose: Review the captured repair, edit its summary and submit it for administrator review.
nodes.visual: Long review form; initial direct-link audit uses a draft, not a populated completed job.
nodes.functional: Submit/review path exercised by repair-browser-check.py.

nodes.title: Administration
nodes.purpose: Enter the review inbox, app-change requests and administration tools.
nodes.visual: Shared-save status block competes with the actual task choices.
nodes.functional: Navigation checked. Production authorization and publication remain unverified.

nodes.title: Review Inbox
nodes.purpose: Find submitted technician work and open its original evidence and proposed changes.
nodes.visual: Empty state is readable; populated review appears in the separate repair workflow.
nodes.functional: Technician submission and administrator review exercised in fixture.

nodes.title: Review submission
nodes.purpose: Read immutable original work, ask for clarification, propose edits, approve and apply changes.
nodes.visual: Without a submission ID this route falls back to the inbox. A base-route screenshot alone cannot prove a review works.
nodes.functional: Populated clarification/proposal/approval/application and original preservation exercised in repair workflow.

nodes.title: App-change requests
nodes.purpose: Review proposed changes to the application and their release-process status.
nodes.visual: Empty-state capture only.
nodes.functional: Navigation checked; a populated request approval/release workflow was not exercised.

nodes.title: Parts Inventory
nodes.purpose: Search parts, photograph or upload a label, correct OCR, store a part, match machines, track locations, low stock and stock movements.
nodes.visual: Duplicate top actions plus seven tabs push the task below the first screen, especially on phones.
nodes.functional: Inventory transaction suite passed desktop/tablet/phone; seven sections captured.

nodes.title: Historical evidence
nodes.purpose: Browse recovered plant evidence, uncertainties and field tasks; follow sources to equipment.
nodes.visual: Repeated introduction and headings delay records. Collapsed-content links appeared in the DOM inventory and could not be clicked while hidden.
nodes.functional: Visible route links checked; hidden-link attempts are inconclusive, not confirmed broken navigation.

nodes.title: Production lines
nodes.purpose: Inspect production lines and their equipment/flow documentation.
nodes.visual: Tabs and repeated heading occupy the top.
nodes.functional: Route links checked; line rationale save/reload passed. Every line and flow variant not exercised.

nodes.title: Documentation queue
nodes.purpose: Prioritize missing field knowledge and documentation work.
nodes.visual: Introductory copy and tabs delay the queue.
nodes.functional: Navigation/geometry captured; new survey task save/reload passed.

nodes.title: Equipment field sheet
nodes.purpose: Record line membership, dependencies and service history for equipment.
nodes.visual: Machine context is repeated before the form.
nodes.functional: Process-stage field save/reload passed. All field-sheet and service-record variants not exercised.

nodes.title: Dependency records
nodes.purpose: Document typed equipment dependencies with supporting evidence.
nodes.visual: Form lies below explanation and production tabs.
nodes.functional: Create an unverified dependency, reload the connections list and open its relationship type: passed.

nodes.title: Directory
nodes.purpose: Find a task; search across equipment, parts and documents.
nodes.visual: Six task cards and More are clear at desktop size. Fails at 320px with 150% text: horizontal clipping.
nodes.functional: Navigation exercised; enlarged-text layout failed.

nodes.title: Map
nodes.purpose: Locate areas and equipment; select a record; edit layout when authorized.
nodes.visual: At 1366×768 the map drawing starts below the first screen. Overview labels remain dense; readable area selection is essential.
nodes.functional: Map-editor transaction suite passed including undo/redo/cancel and reload. Source map accuracy is not certified.

nodes.title: Equipment
nodes.purpose: Search equipment, open a machine, or browse devices grouped by area and line.
nodes.visual: Primary list is straightforward. Device/area mode is denser and contains disclosures.
nodes.functional: Representative machine links clicked. Device mode checked separately; inspect recorded animation/layout findings.

nodes.title: Asset record
nodes.purpose: Read a legacy detailed asset workspace: overview, capture, intelligence, record, documents and activity.
nodes.visual: Black legacy tab strip differs from the newer shell; repeated identity and service link push content down.
nodes.functional: Four explicit tabs captured; not every legacy action or field-capture mutation exercised.

nodes.title: Area details
nodes.purpose: Review equipment and field observations for one area; export its walk pack.
nodes.visual: Global verification information precedes selected-area content. Empty Warehouse E is a legitimate captured state.
nodes.functional: Navigation captured; walk-pack content accuracy not verified.

nodes.title: Documents
nodes.purpose: Search/filter manuals and evidence, open a document, and follow machine context.
nodes.visual: Large filters and group cards make a long list. Selected-document and Draft-filter states captured.
nodes.functional: Document links exercised; evidence image viewer tested separately. Every PDF page and external source not checked.

nodes.title: Control cabinet
nodes.purpose: Inspect a cabinet drawing/photo and choose a contained component.
nodes.visual: Technical workspace uses a different visual style; drawings require contained pan/zoom. Missing-photo state captured for Climax fixture.
nodes.functional: Representative component navigation captured. Every drawing hotspot not individually tested.

nodes.title: Wulftec 3D model
nodes.purpose: Rotate and inspect the reconstructed WCRT-200 model and its assemblies.
nodes.visual: Model begins below controls; technical dimensions and reference text are large.
nodes.functional: Viewer rendered. All camera modes/assemblies and physical accuracy not verified.

nodes.title: Component record
nodes.purpose: Read a device identity, parent equipment, evidence and documented connections.
nodes.visual: Clear identity card but several layers of context precede device details.
nodes.functional: Parent-machine and equipment links clicked.

nodes.title: Field documentation
nodes.purpose: Capture field evidence, observations and documentation against selected equipment.
nodes.visual: Repeated machine title and controls delay entry.
nodes.functional: Render/navigation checked; earlier visual suite covers field workspace. Every capture/apply variant not exercised here.

nodes.title: Troubleshooting
nodes.purpose: Trace documented connections and assess impact around a selected asset.
nodes.visual: Direct entry displays “Select an asset” with no inline asset picker; map is the available next step.
nodes.functional: Direct-state links checked; every relationship traversal not exercised.

nodes.title: More
nodes.purpose: Choose Everyday tasks, Records & review, Admin or Advanced Tools.
nodes.visual: Large group buttons fit desktop; stacked phone choices postpone the actual tool list.
nodes.functional: All groups captured and representative destinations clicked. Earlier large-print workflow checked returning to the selected group.

nodes.title: Account
nodes.purpose: Refresh permissions, set username/password and manage passkeys.
nodes.visual: Readable single-column security form.
nodes.functional: Refresh and username persistence passed in fixture. Real password delivery/passkeys/session policy unverified.

nodes.title: Review changes
nodes.purpose: Compare and apply proposed canonical data changes.
nodes.visual: Shared-save panel precedes the reviewer’s task.
nodes.functional: Proposal workflow covered by fixture suites; real multi-user roles unverified.

nodes.title: Add equipment
nodes.purpose: Create an equipment record with identity, type, area and verification state.
nodes.visual: Large, readable fields; form spans multiple screens.
nodes.functional: Create workflow passed in large-print suite at all three sizes.

nodes.title: Manage assets
nodes.purpose: Find equipment, edit it and manage its record.
nodes.visual: Phone list rows overlap: names and metadata spill into neighboring buttons, and Edit wraps into letters. Machine-scoped entry still presents the whole list.
nodes.functional: Edit, cancelled deletion and CSV readback exercised; irreversible production deletion not performed.

nodes.title: Connections
nodes.purpose: Create an evidence-backed relationship between two assets.
nodes.visual: Long vertical form, with clear source/relationship/destination ordering.
nodes.functional: Verified-without-evidence rejection, unverified creation and reload passed in fixture.

nodes.title: Attach evidence
nodes.purpose: Attach photos/PDFs/files to equipment and reopen them.
nodes.visual: Large upload area; selected asset is repeated in header/form.
nodes.functional: PNG upload, image open/close and reload passed in fixture.

nodes.title: Record a finding
nodes.purpose: Log a field observation against equipment.
nodes.visual: Large clear text entry.
nodes.functional: Save and reload passed in fixture.

nodes.title: Plant setup
nodes.purpose: Edit facility details, areas and map records.
nodes.visual: Three setup sections are visible; forms use generous controls.
nodes.functional: Facility rename/reload and area creation passed. All Map Records operations not exercised.

nodes.title: Plant database
nodes.purpose: Export/import plant backups and equipment packages.
nodes.visual: Confirmed horizontal clipping on 390px phone: statistics/export/options do not fit.
nodes.functional: Export covered in asset workflow. Destructive replacement/import compatibility not exhaustively tested.

nodes.title: Settings
nodes.purpose: Change contrast, motion and map/display preferences.
nodes.visual: Clear large select controls.
nodes.functional: Contrast and reduced-motion persistence passed.

nodes.title: Resolve sync conflicts
nodes.purpose: Compare shared/local conflicts and choose an explicit resolution.
nodes.visual: Empty conflict state has a large shared-save panel above explanation.
nodes.functional: Concurrent conflict, explicit resolution and reload passed in simulated cross-device suite.

nodes.title: Data health
nodes.purpose: Validate the data model and open/trace incomplete records.
nodes.visual: Readable validation panel, but destination controls are deceptive because they do nothing.
nodes.functional: Run verification passed. Open and Trace both failed; dispatch listener is mounted only in Dashboard.

nodes.title: Import records
nodes.purpose: Preview CSV records, validate references and approve import.
nodes.visual: Clear explanation and file picker.
nodes.functional: One asset CSV preview/import/readback passed in fixture. Full malformed-file matrix not exercised.

nodes.title: Guide & training
nodes.purpose: Read workspace guidance, set guide preferences and open the project tour.
nodes.visual: Introductory Genie content dominates the first screen.
nodes.functional: Tour play/next/pause passed at phone and desktop sizes; every guided lesson not exercised.

findings.title: Phone asset tabs conceal the selected section
findings.detail: The phone tab strip initially exposes only Overview. Direct links to Record, Intel, Docs and Capture show different content below, but the selected tab is offscreen in the horizontal strip. Some lower action labels also wrap awkwardly.
findings.fix: Provide a visible current-section selector on phones; avoid making users discover a hidden horizontal tab strip.

findings.title: Manage assets rows overlap on phone
findings.detail: At 390×844, wrapped equipment names and metadata overflow their 72px rows and overlap the next entry. Edit is squeezed into individual letters. This is visible despite passing minimum-font/minimum-target checks.
findings.fix: Prevent list rows from flex-shrinking, allow content-driven height, and reserve space for Edit. Check text containment, not just button dimensions.

findings.title: Data health Open and Trace are dead ends
findings.detail: Both clicks leave the page unchanged. PlantManager dispatches iag-focus-verification-target, but only Dashboard installs its listener and Dashboard is not mounted on this route.
findings.fix: Navigate through the shared router, then focus the requested record/trace. Add tests from the actual health route.

findings.title: Plant database clips horizontally on phone
findings.detail: Reproduced at 390×844 in the full large-print route suite. Statistics, export and replacement controls extend past the available width.
findings.fix: Stack the statistics and import choices on phones; allow labels to wrap and constrain field widths.

findings.title: Directory fails with enlarged text on a narrow phone
findings.detail: At 320×900 and 150% text, page-scroll reports clientWidth 340 and scrollWidth 374. The repair suite stops here after its core transaction checks.
findings.fix: Make shell/navigation and task cards reflow at 320px with enlarged text; retain the failing assertion.

findings.title: The first screen often shows chrome instead of the task
findings.detail: Large type is present, but repeated titles, context, tabs, status blocks and introductory copy consume the initial viewport. Map drawing is below the initial desktop fold; inventory entry is displaced by duplicate navigation.
findings.fix: Keep one useful title/context line. Put the main action or working surface immediately beneath it, and disclose secondary navigation/status.

findings.title: Legacy technical workspaces use a different interaction pattern
findings.detail: Legacy black tabs and technical panels coexist with newer task cards. Direct Troubleshooting entry asks for an asset without an inline picker.
findings.fix: Use consistent task navigation and provide a clear asset selector at an empty trace entry.
